newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: INSTANT VIEW - Bank of Portugal cuts rates.
newsitem.headline: INSTANT VIEW - Bank of Portugal cuts rates.

text.p: The following are some comments from analysts to the Bank of Portugal's cutting 30 basis points off its official market rates.

"I believe that it confirms the expectations for a good inflation figure for June which will be released on Monday. It is taking advantage of the stability in the international markets to make a cut (we had expected) for next week."
